messages:
morgan: Repro for a parity issue across sampleapps: req_id present in OTLP spans but shows as <redacted> in some logs after an auth retry. Likely hook ordering.

ida: Which samples and minimal steps?

morgan: node/go/python samples. Steps: start with REDACT=1 LOG_LEVEL=info OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318, trigger /auth that returns 401 then 200. Logs: `INFO auth start req_id=abc123`, `DEBUG http retry`, `INFO auth success req_id=<redacted>` but OTLP span has req_id=abc123.

pranav: Sounds like redaction runs on formatted text before span attrs are attached. Quick mitigation: attach req_id to context/span at handler entry so formatter can read structured field.

ida: Can we also update quickstarts to recommend LOG_LEVEL=info for onboarding? Debug changes timing and surfaces the race.

pranav: Long term: make redaction prefer structured span/MDC attributes and fall back to regex. That's more robust with async exporters/batching.

morgan: I'll open a small PR to attach req_id early in each sample and add a smoke test that forces the 401->200 retry. ci-bot: Created TICKET-8001: "sampleapps: deterministic req_id propagation + redaction during retry flows" (https://redwood.internal/TICKET-8001).

ida: Thanks — paste any cross-runtime logs into the ticket so we can generalize.
